The group looks trustworthy, but you decide to keep your distance. You exchange information and then continue alone.
You find a service ladder bolted to the side of the building. It descends to a delivery alley on the north side. A path opens up.
The roof access door is unlocked. You find a set of stairs leading back down into the building's upper floor.
From the roof, you spot a clear path through the back streets. You and Marcus descend and move quickly, avoiding the main roads.
A nearby fire station has its doors open. There might be emergency vehicles or communication equipment inside.
The creature rounds the corner and sees you. It lets out a shriek and lunges. You swing the lamp like a club, connecting with its head. It crumples.
You fire the extinguisher, filling the alley with a cloud of white foam. The creature shrieks and recoils, giving you time to run.
You approach the military checkpoint with your hands raised. Soldiers in full combat gear aim rifles at you before lowering them. 'You're safe now. Get in the truck.'
The military is shooting everything that moves. You can't be sure they won't shoot you too. You bypass the checkpoint and continue north on foot.

Apartment 3C.name: Apartment 3C
Apartment 3C.vignette: Your small, cluttered one-bedroom apartment on the third floor of an aging brick walk-up. The space is now plunged into darkness, lit only by the faint glow of the city's dying fires through the window.
Apartment 3C.appearanceDescription: A modest apartment with worn hardwood floors, a kitchenette to the left, a small living area with a couch and coffee table, and a hallway leading to the bedroom and bathroom. The power is out, so everything is cast in deep shadows. The window overlooking the street shows an orange glow from distant fires.
Apartment 3C.backstoryDescription: You've lived here for three years. It's not much, but it's been home. The walls are thin, and you know your neighbors by their footsteps and arguments.

Building Hallway.name: Building Hallway
Building Hallway.vignette: The narrow, dim corridor of the third floor with faded floral wallpaper and a single emergency light flickering weakly. The air smells of old carpet and something metallic, like blood.
Building Hallway.appearanceDescription: A long, narrow hallway with doors to apartments 3A, 3B, and 3C (yours), plus the stairwell door at the end. The emergency light casts sickly yellow pools of light, and the wallpaper is peeling in places.
Building Hallway.backstoryDescription: You've walked this hallway hundreds of times, greeting neighbors you barely know. Tonight, it feels like a trap.

City Streets.name: City Streets
City Streets.vignette: The chaotic urban landscape below your window. Cars are abandoned at odd angles, some still running with headlights cutting through smoke. Sirens wail in the distance, and shadows move between the wreckage.
City Streets.appearanceDescription: A city street in chaos. Overturned cars, flickering streetlights, shattered storefront windows. The sky is hazy with smoke, and the orange glow of fires paints everything in hellish hues. Strange, skittering shapes can be seen moving in the periphery.
City Streets.backstoryDescription: The city was once bustling and alive. Tonight, it's a war zone, though no one is sure who or what the enemy is.

Fire Escape.name: Fire Escape
Fire Escape.vignette: The rusted metal ladder and platform attached to the building's exterior, accessible from your kitchen window. It leads down to the alleyway below, where the howling sound came from.
Fire Escape.appearanceDescription: A narrow, grated metal platform with a ladder descending into darkness. The metal is cold and rough with rust. From here, you can see into neighboring apartments and down into the shadow-choked alley.
Fire Escape.backstoryDescription: The fire escape has always been your emergency exit, though you never thought you'd actually need it. It groans under weight but holds.

Marcus.name: Marcus
Marcus.vignette: Marcus Chen is your neighbor from apartment 3B, a graphic designer in his late twenties. He's always been friendly, if a bit nosy, and you've borrowed sugar from each other more than once.
Marcus.appearanceDescription: A man of average height with messy black hair, glasses, and a panicked expression. He's wearing a stained t-shirt and sweatpants, and his hands are trembling as he pounds on your door.
Marcus.backstoryDescription: Marcus has lived next door for about two years. He works freelance, so you often hear his keyboard clacking through the walls at odd hours. He has a cat named Pixel.

The Narrator.name: The Narrator
The Narrator.vignette: Your own inner voice, the survival instinct that's now screaming at you to make a decision before it's too late.
The Narrator.appearanceDescription: No physical form. This is the voice in your head, the one that's keeping you alive.
The Narrator.backstoryDescription: You are you. A regular person, maybe in your 20s or 30s, who was just trying to get through another evening when the world ended.
